error.machineGone: That machine is no longer in the list
error.machineDisconnected: That machine is no longer connected
error.openFailed: That project could not be opened
error.projectNotSaved: The project could not be saved
error.reopenFailed: The project could not be opened again
error.idsTaken: Another copy of this canvas is open on this machine, from another checkout of the same repository. Close that project first, or the two would share their terminals and chats.

close.idle: Nothing in this project is running. It moves to Recent just as you left it.
close.ending_one: Closing ends its running session. A terminal loses its scrollback and an agent stops. The rest moves to Recent as you left it.
close.ending_other: Closing ends its {{count}} running sessions. A terminal loses its scrollback and an agent stops. The rest moves to Recent as you left it.
close.held_one: Another client still has this project open, so nothing stops running. It moves to Recent here only.
close.held_other: {{count}} other clients still have this project open, so nothing stops running. It moves to Recent here only.

showView.alreadyThere: {{agent}} pointed at {{view}}, which you were already looking at
showView.follow: {{agent}} showed {{view}} in the cell you were working in

diagram.draft: Fill the empty diagram "{{name}}" with `ruimte-context view diagram {{viewId}}`. It should show

moveChat.failedToRender: The move dialog failed to render
moveChat.name: Name
moveChat.conflict: {{name}} is already in {{project}}. Leave the files in Chats, or rename it there first.
moveChat.references_one: One chat in Chats is attached to this one with @. After the move, that chat can no longer read this one.
moveChat.references_other: {{count}} chats in Chats are attached to this one with @. After the move, they can no longer read this one.
moveChat.failed: The chat could not be moved
moveChat.infoFailed: The machine could not say where this chat worked

refusal.not-in-chats: Only a chat in Chats can move to a project.
refusal.working: This chat is still working. Stop it or wait for it to finish, then try again.
refusal.agents: This chat started agents of its own, or an agent started it. A chat with agents cannot move to a project yet.
refusal.tasks: This chat gave a task or has one. A chat with tasks cannot move to a project yet.
refusal.owedAt: This chat resumes by itself at {{time}}. Write in it or turn off resuming first.
refusal.owed: The machine still has work queued for this chat. Try again once it is done.
refusal.messages: Messages from other chats are waiting for this chat. It reads them in its next turn. Move it after that.
refusal.pr-watch: This chat watches a pull request. Stop watching it first.
